reuse.why: Adds the template rule inside the existing shouldFillCategory, the tree's single definition of which categories month-wide actions write, which copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions already call.

duplication.why: One small hasSavedTemplates predicate and one extra selected column; nothing copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts with its doc comment updated, and the data comes from the existing queries.

scope.why: Only the selection rule, its inputs and removal of the now-unneeded includeHidden option.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised, and dropping includeHidden removes setZero's special case; no tests were added for the new exclusions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action decides through shouldFillCategory.

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory (with hasSavedTemplates) in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getCategoriesForAverage.
